reconciliation.label: BSP/ARC Reconciliation
reconciliation.syncrevenue: Automatically detects settlement discrepancies before revenue leaks continue.
reconciliation.legacy: Spreadsheet matching after closing leaves issues for monthly cleanup.
reconciliation.generic: Does not model airline settlement workflows without heavy configuration.

debitMemo.label: Debit Memo Dispute Management
debitMemo.syncrevenue: Links each dispute to commission context, booking history, and recovery status.
debitMemo.legacy: Teams track reason codes and supporting notes manually.
debitMemo.generic: Requires custom task processes to keep disputes and commissions connected.

gdsIntegration.label: Multi-GDS Integration
gdsIntegration.syncrevenue: Covers Amadeus, Sabre, Galileo, and Worldspan commission workflows.
gdsIntegration.legacy: Depends on copied exports or isolated single-GDS views.
gdsIntegration.generic: Requires CSV imports and manual mapping before analysis can start.

reporting.label: Real-Time Commission Reporting
reporting.syncrevenue: Shows recovery status and commission exceptions as work progresses.
reporting.legacy: Monthly reporting delays visibility into missed or disputed revenue.
reporting.generic: Dashboards depend on manual refreshes and spreadsheet upkeep.

audit.label: Automated Audit Trail
audit.syncrevenue: Creates system records for reconciliation actions, disputes, and outcomes.
audit.legacy: Evidence is scattered across emails, files, and individual spreadsheets.
audit.generic: Stores attachments or notes without travel-specific traceability.

security.headline: Your Data is Protected
security.subtext: We take the security of your GDS credentials and booking data seriously.

encryption.title: Encrypted Transmission
encryption.description: All data transmitted between your systems and SyncRevenue is encrypted in transit using industry-standard protocols.

certification.title: Certification Roadmap
certification.description: We are actively pursuing SOC 2 Type II certification. Our security roadmap is transparent and available on request.

insurance.title: Contract Insurance
insurance.description: Our service agreements include explicit data protection commitments and liability coverage for commission recovery operations.

security.separation: GDS credentials never touch our website. All data access is scoped exclusively to commission reconciliation — no passenger data, no booking modifications.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Sync Sirius, Inc. is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect information submitted through this website.

dataCollection.title: Information We Collect
dataCollection.body: We collect contact information (name, email, company, phone) and usage information submitted through demo request and contact forms.

dataUse.title: How We Use Your Information
dataUse.body: We use your information to respond to demo requests, answer inquiries, and improve our services. We do not sell your data to third parties.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.body: Demo request and contact records are retained for 24 months from submission, then permanently deleted.

gdsData.title: GDS Credentials & Booking Data
gdsData.body: This website does not collect GDS credentials or booking data. All GDS integration for SyncRevenue customers occurs through direct API agreements, not through this website.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: For privacy inquiries, contact us at privacy@syncsirius.com.
